name: 示例商品500ml
category: 根类目 / 二级类目 / 三级类目
_notes: This is what the agent reads back off the filled form, before it is allowed to submit; verify_item.py compares it against the queue item and the profile.
category must be the whole path as the form shows it - verify_item compares it exactly, and a parent node with the same label as the leaf is the classic false match.
specValues keeps the on-form order: the unit row has to come before the case row, because rows can only be appended.
skuRows may also be arrays ([3.0, 10000, 0.8]) and are then keyed by profile fields.spec.skuFieldOrder.
images[].bytes is the size of the STORED object fetched back from the thumbnail URL, not the local file size - a white crop compresses to a few KB and that is how it gets caught.
checked is how many controls are ticked on the form, asserted against profile.defaults.checkedToStart rather than clicked blind.
submitted is what the page state says, not what the agent intended: in fill-only mode a true here is an out-of-mode failure.
category is compared segment by segment, so the page may render 'RootCat > 饮料 > 茶饮料' while the plan spells it with ' / ' - the levels themselves still have to match exactly.

for a product with real variants (colours, sizes), declare them all in the queue item's specValues: the gate then blocks any value the plan lacks and checks the rows by name. Otherwise an undeclared extra row blocks the submit unless the run passes --allow-extra-specs.
